response.edited_text: I would not recommend this executive notebook. Its rigid cover makes it difficult to open, ink passes through to the sheet underneath, and the ribbon detached before I reached page three. The description promised an effortless writing experience, but that has not been my experience. I have used the notebook for a week, mostly with the same fountain pen I use in my ordinary notebook, which does not show ink on the reverse. I would not buy this one again. The shop offered a replacement, but I declined because I did not want another copy of the same notebook.
